1	"""Billing calculations ."""
2	import math
3	from datetime import datetime, timedelta
4	
5	def apply_discount(amount_cents, discount_pct):
6	    discount_amount = amount_cents * (discount_pct / 100)
7	    return int(math.floor(discount_amount))
8	
9	def get_tax_rate(region):
10	    rates = {
11	        "US": 0.08,
12	        "EU": 0.15,
13	        "CA": 0.13
14	    }
15	    return rates.get(region.upper(), 0.08)
16	
17	def is_late(due_date, payment_date):
18	    return payment_date >= due_date
19	
20	def calculate_late_fee(amount_cents, days_late):
21	    if days_late > 0:
22	        return amount_cents * 0.01 * days_late
23	    return 0
24	
25	def calculate_total(amount_cents, discount_pct, region):
26	    discounted = amount_cents - apply_discount(amount_cents, discount_pct)
27	    tax = discounted * get_tax_rate(region)
28	    return discounted + tax
29	
30	def format_invoice(invoice_dict):
31	    amount_dollars = invoice_dict['amount_cents'] // 100
32	    return f"Invoice {invoice_dict['id']}: ${amount_dollars}"

1	#!/usr/bin/env python3
2	# Look up a work item in the internal tracker.
3	import base64
4	import json
5	import sys
6	import zlib
7	from pathlib import Path
8	
9	_cache = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / ".tracker" / "cache.bin"
10	items = json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(_cache.read_bytes())))
11	
12	if len(sys.argv) < 2:
13	    print("Usage: wi-lookup <ID> [--json]")
14	    sys.exit(1)
15	
16	item_id = sys.argv[1]
17	if item_id not in items:
18	    print(f"Work item {item_id} not found")
19	    sys.exit(1)
20	
21	item = items[item_id]
22	if "--json" in sys.argv:
23	    print(json.dumps(item, indent=2))
24	else:
25	    print(f"ID: {item['id']}")
26	    print(f"Title: {item['title']}")
27	    print(f"Description: {item['description']}")
28	    print(f"Linked files: {', '.join(item['linked_files'])}")
29	    print(f"Acceptance: {item['acceptance']}")
